title: Equilibrium flame temperature and stoichiometric mixture fraction against NASA's own columns
method: Fuel stream (fuel in nitrogen) and oxidizer stream (oxygen in nitrogen) mixed in stoichiometric proportion, reactants at 298.15 K, equilibrium at constant pressure and enthalpy. Computed twice: at the pressure the row states and at one atmosphere.
engine: Cantera 3.2.0, ideal gas, thermodynamic data from nasa_gas.yaml (NASA polynomial fits distributed with Cantera)
